Tonight at 9 PM ET, on ABC News, I will be hosting “The Patriot Games,” an Athletic Competition featuring many great young people from across the Country, all of whom participated in the celebration of our Nation`s 250th Birthday! It is my Great Honor to host the Final Games, and cheer on these very special young American Athletes. TUNE IN! President DONALD J. TRUMP

- (@realDonaldTrump) August 13, 2026
